chapters.title: Incomplete conquest
chapters.summary: After Joshua's death the tribes fight on, but many fail to drive out the Canaanites and live alongside them.

chapters.title: The cycle begins
chapters.summary: A new generation forgets the Lord and serves the Baals. God hands them to enemies, raises up judges to rescue them, and they fall away again.

chapters.title: Othniel, Ehud and Shamgar
chapters.summary: The first judges rescue Israel: Othniel defeats an Aramean king, left-handed Ehud kills fat King Eglon of Moab, and Shamgar strikes the Philistines.

chapters.title: Deborah and Barak
chapters.summary: The prophetess Deborah summons Barak to fight Sisera's army. God routs it, and Sisera dies at the hand of Jael.

chapters.title: The song of Deborah
chapters.summary: Deborah and Barak sing of the victory, praising the tribes that came, shaming those that stayed home, and honoring Jael.

chapters.title: The call of Gideon
chapters.summary: Midian oppresses Israel. The angel of the Lord calls Gideon, a fearful farmer, who tears down his father's Baal altar and asks for signs with a fleece.

chapters.title: Gideon's three hundred
chapters.summary: God reduces Gideon's army to three hundred men so Israel cannot boast. With trumpets, jars and torches they rout the Midianite camp.

chapters.title: Gideon's later years
chapters.summary: Gideon pursues the Midianite kings and refuses to be king, but makes a gold ephod that becomes a snare. After his death Israel turns again to Baal.

chapters.title: Abimelech
chapters.summary: Gideon's son Abimelech kills seventy brothers to become king. Jotham tells a fable about trees choosing a king, and Abimelech dies when a woman drops a millstone on him.

chapters.title: Tola, Jair and repentance
chapters.summary: Two judges lead quietly. Then Israel serves many gods and is oppressed by the Philistines and Ammonites, until they repent and put away their idols.

chapters.title: Jephthah's vow
chapters.summary: Jephthah, an outcast, leads Israel against Ammon. He makes a rash vow that ends in tragedy for his only daughter.

chapters.title: Ephraim and the later judges
chapters.summary: Ephraim quarrels with Jephthah and loses many men at the Jordan, given away by how they say "Shibboleth". Three minor judges follow.

chapters.title: The birth of Samson
chapters.summary: The angel of the Lord announces to a barren woman that she will bear a son, a Nazirite who will begin to rescue Israel from the Philistines.

chapters.title: Samson's riddle
chapters.summary: Samson kills a lion barehanded and later finds honey in its carcass. He marries a Philistine woman, and his riddle at the wedding feast leads to violence.

chapters.title: The jawbone
chapters.summary: Samson takes revenge on the Philistines with burning foxes, and later kills a thousand men with a donkey's jawbone. God gives him water from a hollow place.

chapters.title: Samson and Delilah
chapters.summary: Delilah betrays Samson's secret, his head is shaved, and the Philistines blind him. In the temple of Dagon he prays once more and pulls it down.

chapters.title: Micah's idols
chapters.summary: A man named Micah makes his own shrine and hires a Levite as priest. In those days there was no king and everyone did what was right in their own eyes.

chapters.title: The Danites move north
chapters.summary: The tribe of Dan seizes Micah's idols and priest and conquers the peaceful town of Laish, setting up their own place of worship.

chapters.title: The Levite's concubine
chapters.summary: A Levite's concubine is abused and killed by men of Gibeah in Benjamin. He sends her body in pieces throughout Israel, calling for action.

chapters.title: War with Benjamin
chapters.summary: Israel gathers to punish Gibeah. Benjamin refuses to hand over the guilty, and after heavy losses Israel nearly destroys the tribe.

chapters.title: Wives for Benjamin
chapters.summary: Israel grieves that a tribe is almost lost and finds wives for the surviving Benjamites by troubling means. Everyone did what was right in their own eyes.
